about_the_game:
Scarred Steel is a brutal medieval roguelite where every scar tells your story. Permanent injuries, hard choices, and bloody duels shape your path in a dying world.

What’s in this demo

  • 30–60 minutes of early-game content

  • Tutorial & first encounters (arena/town intro)

  • A slice of the combat loop (weapons, armor, injuries)

  • Keyboard/Mouse and Controller support

  • Progress does not carry over to the full game (work-in-progress)

Core features (full game)

  • Tactical melee duels – timing, stamina, positioning matter

  • Persistent wounds & scars – injuries change how you fight and survive

  • Meaningful decisions – choose who to help, betray, or endure

  • Build variety – weapons, armor, and perks that alter your style

  • Replayable runs – die, learn, adapt

Feedback

This demo is WIP. Please share bugs and thoughts on the Steam Discussions, it helps a ton.

➡️ Enjoyed the slice? Please Wishlist the full game on the main page to get notified on updates and release.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game includes graphic medieval violence, blood, and injury. Players will experience intense combat, death, and survival scenarios in a dark, plague-ridden world.

Mature themes include:

- Realistic injury and blood effects in combat
- Descriptions of disease, suffering, and societal collapse
- Grim tone and survivalist narrative elements

There is no sexual content, no drug use, no self-harm, and no depictions of sexual assault.

These mature elements appear in both gameplay and narrative sequences from early in the game and continue throughout.
